item.title: mac4DSTEM 5.3.1
item.description:
mac4DSTEM 5.3.1 fixes wrong or misleading results.
• Placing a virtual detector no longer moves the origin. You now set the origin on purpose in Prepare. • Phase mapping refuses an unmeasured origin, a typed orientation relationship covers all its variants, and Fit Distortion fits the right matrix. • Calibrate Q reads diamond-type rings correctly. • Opening a dataset writes nothing to its disk, and a new file no longer shows the last file's EDS maps. • A tidier status bar, keyboard and VoiceOver fixes, and a new update signing key.
